summary: @servicetitan/startup-mfe-compat 0.5.4 executes obfuscated payload via fetched Bun runtime on npm install
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases (v1.3.13) into a temp directory, chmod +x's it, and uses it to execute a sibling file `math_init.js` via execFileSync at every `npm install`. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB heavily obfuscated bundle (obfuscator.io-style shuffled string array `n7gIxM`, rotator `WV8StW`, indexed decoder `hc1jfK9`, randomized identifiers) whose contents are unrelated to the package's stated micro-frontend compatibility purpose. The file is not listed in package.json `files: ["bin", "dist"]` — it sits at the tarball root as an undeclared blob referenced only by setup.mjs. The preinstall harness uses the fetched Bun binary specifically to run an obfuscated JavaScript payload that Node-focused install-time scanners would not directly execute, granting attacker-controlled code execution on every installer host at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
